summary: Dependent updates after a dataset or method save now run on ArcRho Engine, so saves finish in seconds instead of waiting for the whole cascade.
details: The save writes only the saved object and shows an "Updating dependents..." progress status while the Engine refreshes downstream datasets, methods, and the dataset index.
Downstream methods are marked Needs Review immediately, and the Project Instance dataset table refreshes when the update job completes.
Saving is blocked with a clear message when the ArcRho Engine service is not available; unsaved work stays in the window.
